Lead: Orchard Sprint AI — early inbound via signup form + demo request. SMB, mid-growth (support SaaS). Wants to integrate an assistant into their in-app help and also run weekly doc embeddings for search. Cost sensitivity flagged heavily on first call.

Highlights / requirements (from calls):
- Primary: Hosted API (self-serve) — want fast time-to-value, no infra lift.
- Key asks: aggressive cost optimization (batching, prefix caching, prompt compression), tooling to audit token usage per-route.
- Targets: average response latency < 600ms for short chat flows; 5–10 QPS steady, spikes to 30 QPS during business hours. Unit-cost must be < current OpenAI baseline by ~20-30% to justify migration.
- Model preferences: open to Llama2 / Mistral flavors; prefer Redwood-curated small/med models with quantization.
- Routing/fallback: want simple fallback path to smaller model for non-critical flows.
- Security: company uses SSO (SAML) and requires audit logging for admin console actions; no on-prem.
